snippet.title: Budgeting For Beginners #budget #money #moneymindset #financetips #finance #investing #moneymindset
snippet.description:
Most people have no idea where their money goes every month. I didn't either — until I found out I was losing over $5,400 a year on completely untracked spending. Coffee. Subscriptions. Small purchases that felt harmless. All of it adding up silently in the background.
In this video I break down exactly what a budget is, why you need one even if you think you don't earn enough, and how to start one today — without spreadsheets, without stress, and without giving up the things you enjoy.
As a medical doctor, I explain money the same way I explain health — simply, clearly, and without making you feel stupid for not knowing it already.
By the end of this video you will understand:
— What a budget actually is (it is not what most people think)
— Why most people avoid budgets and why they are wrong
— The three symptoms of life without a budget
— How a basic budget works in four simple steps
— The 50/30/20 rule and how to apply it to your income
YOUR FIRST SMART MONEY SMART MOVE:
Tonight — not tomorrow — write down every expense from this week. Just look. No judgment. That single act is the beginning of financial health.

If you’re being overlooked for a promotion or raise, 
If you’re changing jobs or looking for a job,
If you’ve been feeling uneasy about changes in tech and AI,
If the feeling at work is “anything could happen…” 

This episode is for you.

The world is moving fast, companies are shifting, and a lot of people are sitting back and hoping they don’t get hit.

She will tell you exactly which skills, what mindset, and what actions you need to take in 2026 to succeed at work so you can position yourself so you’re not waiting for someone else to “notice” your potential.

Instead, give people a role.

Let them bring something. Share something. Contribute in their own way.

Because the moment people feel like it’s their gathering too, things get lighter.. People loosen up, laugh more and really connect.

On this episode of The Mel Robbins Podcast, Priya Parker shares simple ways to make time together feel more fun, more meaningful, and truly unforgettable.
